evidence.title: SciSpace Premium - Unlimited access to AI research tools

name: SciSpace
summary: AI research assistant for PDF chat, literature search and academic writing.
description: SciSpace chats with any PDF for citation-linked answers and runs literature searches over 280M+ papers. It bundles an AI writer, paraphraser, AI detector, citation generator with 2,300+ styles, multi-PDF data extraction, PDF-to-video and academic writing templates. Free tier with limits; Premium and Advanced plans unlock unlimited access.
contains: chat with PDF: citation-linked answers with paragraph references
AI writer, paraphraser, AI detector and AI humanizer
extract findings and tables from multiple PDFs
academic writing templates and resources hub
